$description: Rhythm and position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py; every rule id here has an implementation there and vice versa (checked by verify_all.py). Each rule was checked against the real node sequences in templates/templates.json when written (Master guide 3.18); exceptions are named with reasons.

rules.description: Per-section constraints from each contract: onePerPage, maxPerPage, mustBeFirst, mustBeLast, mustFollowNav, mustPrecedeFooter, mustPrecedeTalkModal, mustFollowSection, homeRouteOnly, routeOnly, chromeAxis. Checked against all 30 templates.

Nodes start with the chrome frame for the declared chrome axis and end with it: dark-home = navbar-dark, mobile-nav-dark ... talk-modal (no footer, no banner, no CTA band); light-banner-cta = announcement-bar, navbar-light, mobile-nav-light ... footer, talk-modal; light-cta / light-no-cta = navbar-light, mobile-nav-light ... footer, talk-modal.
A snake CTA band is present exactly once when chrome is light-banner-cta or light-cta (and then sits directly before the footer), and absent for light-no-cta and dark-home.
The first non-chrome node is a HERO-category section, except the templates that open with a CMS / listing / utility header.

exceptions.reason: opens with listing.blog-header (a listing header, no hero section in the source DOM)
opens with content.post-header (breadcrumb, H1, byline rows)
the 404 page is stripes + art + message with no hero section
a single application column that opens with content.padel-apply
opens directly with the booking split (conversion.booking-split); no hero section

rules.description: At most one HERO node per page; a companion visual (hero.product-visual, hero.startups-visual) does not count and must directly follow its parent hero.

The same (section, variant) never appears twice in a row. Variant = the content field named by the contract variantField (features.accordion-tabs imageSide, content.playground-empty-blocks blockMode), so two stacked accordion rows must alternate image side.
proof.logos-row directly follows hero.product-visual (7 product pages) or content.video-section (/bi-as-code).
content.blog-posts, when present, directly follows content.faq (true on /data-apps, /self-improving-analytics, /bi-as-code).
No more than three consecutive nodes of the same category (CHROME ignored).

exceptions.reason: real page runs four FEATURES sections in a row (two accordion rows, 2x2 cards, icon grid)
real page runs four FEATURES sections in a row (split, 1x3 cards, icon grid, comparison table)

rules.description: At most three hatched bands per page (/embedding has exactly three).
At most one auto-advancing carousel / accordion per page (/partnerships and /fintech have exactly one each).
